title: The latest report
description: A story lesson about a newspaper report on actress Karen Marsh. Karen told reporters that she might retire, that she couldn't make up her mind, that she would have to ask her future husband, and that her future husband would not let her make another film. The lesson introduces the use of 'would' and 'would have to' in reported speech. The workbook drills reported-speech comprehension questions about the story and vocabulary fill-in; the grammar workbook rewrites sentences using 'said'/'told' with 'would', completes a dialogue with reported-speech words, and rewrites 'would have to' sentences in reported speech.
answer_note: Grammar restored from PDF pp.411–413 and answer pp.570–571. Slash pronouns preserve printed alternatives; audio uses the singular model. Other sections retain their recorded sources. Grammar source audit: see reports/grammar-source-audit.json; source section order, complete prompts and answers restored.

lesson.text: Listen to the tape and then answer the question that follows. 听录音，然后回答所接下来的问题。
lesson.translation: 听录音，然后回答所接下来的问题。

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Are you really going to retire, Miss Marsh?
lines.translation: 马什小姐，您真的准备退休吗？

lines.speaker: Miss Marsh
lines.text: I may. I can't make up my mind. I will have to ask my future husband. He won't let me make another film.
lines.translation: 有可能。我拿不定主意。我得问问我的未婚夫。他不会让我再拍电影了。

lines.speaker: Miss Marsh
lines.text: Yes. Let me introduce him to you. His name is Carlos. We're going to get married next week.
lines.translation: 是的。让我把他介绍给您。他叫卡洛斯。我们打算下星期结婚。

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.text: Look, Liz! Here's another report about Karen Marsh. Listen. Karen Marsh: The latest. At her London Hotel today Miss Marsh told reporters she might retire. She said she couldn't make up her mind. She said she would have to ask her future husband. She said her future husband would not let her make another film. Then she introduced us to Carlos and told us they would get married next week.
lines.translation: 瞧，莉兹！这里又有一篇关于卡伦·马什的报道。听着：卡伦·马什——最新消息。 今天在伦敦的旅馆里，马什小姐告诉记者她可能要退休。她说她拿不定主意。 她说她得问问她的未婚夫。她说她的未婚夫不会再让她拍电影了。 随后她向我们介绍了卡洛斯，并告诉我们他们下星期要结婚。

lines.speaker: Liz
lines.text: That's sensational news, isn't it, Kate?
lines.translation: 这可是轰动的新闻，对吧，凯特？

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.text: It certainly is. He'll be her sixth husband!
lines.translation: 当然了。他将是她的第六任丈夫！

lesson.text: Is Karen Marsh going to retire, do you think?
lesson.translation: 你认为卡伦·马什会退休吗？

items.title: would 在间接引语中的用法
items.text: 在间接引语中，will 变为 would：She said (that) she would retire. / She told reporters (that) she might retire.

items.title: would have to
items.text: 「不得不」在间接引语中用 would have to：She said that she would have to ask her future husband.

items.title: might 的用法
items.text: 「可能」在间接引语中可以用 might：She told reporters that she might retire.

practice.title: Practice A: Comprehension (Karen Marsh report)
practice.instruction: Look at the latest newspaper report about Karen Marsh at the bottom of Students' Book page 273 and answer these questions. 参见学生用书第 273 页的底部有关卡伦·马什的最新报道，然后回答以下问题。
practice.translation: 参见学生用书第 273 页的底部有关卡伦·马什的最新报道，然后回答以下问题。
practice.context: 4 comprehension questions about the Karen Marsh newspaper report, answered using reported speech.

questions.prompt: What did Karen Marsh tell reporters at her London hotel? (What did she actually say? What were her actual words?)
questions.answer: She told reporters that she might retire. Her actual words were: 'I might retire.'

questions.prompt: Did she say that she could, or couldn't make up her mind? (What did she actually say? What were her actual words?)
questions.answer: She said that she couldn't make up her mind. Her actual words were: 'I can't make up my mind.'

questions.prompt: Who did she say she would have to ask? (What did she actually say? What were her actual words?)
questions.answer: She said that she would have to ask her future husband. Her actual words were: 'I will have to ask my future husband.'

questions.prompt: Who did she say would not let her make another film? (What did she actually say? What were her actual words?)
questions.answer: She said that her future husband would not let her make another film. Her actual words were: 'He won't let me make another film.'

practice.title: Practice B: Vocabulary (choose the correct word)
practice.instruction: Choose and write in the correct words in these sentences. 选词填空。

questions.prompt: That actor has ______ twenty films in his life. (done / made)
questions.answer: made

questions.prompt: 'This is my third ______,' the woman said when we met. (man / husband)
questions.answer: husband

questions.prompt: Those people ______ abroad for their holidays every year. (go / leave)
questions.answer: go

questions.prompt: Two friends of ours are ______ married next September. (going / getting)
questions.answer: getting

questions.prompt: 'This is my last job,' he said. 'I'm 60 and I'm going to ______.' (retire / leave)
questions.answer: retire

questions.prompt: 'I must ______ you to my wife,' the man said to me. (tell / introduce)
questions.answer: introduce
